ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: UpgradeableConnection::graceful_shutdown must be a no-op when the connection has already been upgraded (inner = None). Previously it unconditionally called self.inner.as_mut().unwrap(), causing a panic if graceful_shutdown was invoked after the upgrade transition.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title 'fix: avoid panic when calling `graceful_shutdown` if H1 connection was upgraded' and body 'Closes #3615 / Added test which fails without these changes' directly identify the panic-on-upgrade bug. The diff guards the unwrap with `if let Some(conn) = self.inner.as_mut()` and adds http1_graceful_shutdown_after_upgrade asserting 'graceful shutdown doesn't cause issues or panic. It should be ignored after upgrade'.
